databases.actionsDescV016: Full server backup uses mysqldump --all-databases. Restore streams any .sql file from disk through the MySQL client (recommended for large dumps). phpMyAdmin supports smaller uploads up to your configured PHP limit.
databases.restorePartialWarning: Import may partially apply before failing; there is no automatic rollback. For very large dumps, use this dialog instead of phpMyAdmin.
databases.restoreModeFollow: Restore using database names in the file (recommended for DevStackBox backups and mysqldump --databases)
databases.restoreModeInitial: Use a selected database when the file does not specify one (does not override USE or CREATE DATABASE inside the file)

databases.createIfNotExists: Create database if it does not exist

databases.applyPhpImportLimitsDesc: Sets upload 512M, post 544M, and 600s execution time in global php.ini for phpMyAdmin. Restart Apache afterward.
databases.restoreHintCreateDatabase: This file appears to contain CREATE DATABASE statements. Use “Restore using database names in the file”.

ssl.caGenerated: Local Root CA generated (DevStackBox Local CA)
ssl.generateDesc: Creates a Local Root CA (DevStackBox Local CA) then signs a 10-year localhost certificate with it. Re-run to regenerate the localhost cert without touching the CA.
ssl.enableDesc: Adds mod_ssl and an HTTPS VirtualHost (port 443) to Apache config. Generates a certificate if one does not exist yet.
ssl.disableDesc: Removes the SSL Include from httpd.conf. Certificate files are kept so SSL can be re-enabled without regenerating.
ssl.trustTitle: Trust the Root CA in Windows (one-time)
ssl.trustDesc: Import the CA certificate once. Every certificate DevStackBox generates - for localhost and future virtual hosts - is then trusted automatically. No more browser warnings.
ssl.trustStep2: Navigate to Trusted Root Certification Authorities > Certificates.
ssl.trustStep3: Right-click and choose All Tasks > Import...
ssl.trustStep4: Browse to ca.crt (path shown below) and complete the import wizard.
ssl.trustStep5: Restart your browser. All DevStackBox HTTPS sites will be trusted without any further action.
ssl.generateFirst: Generate the CA first to see its path.

backup.includedItem1: User configuration files, excluding HTTPS/SSL private material and transient locks
backup.includedItem2: Files in the default www folder. Files in connected folders outside www are not included.
backup.includedItem3: MySQL databases via mysqldump (all-databases.sql) - requires MySQL to be running
backup.binariesNote: Binaries (Apache, PHP, MySQL) are not included - they can be reinstalled.
backup.noBackups: No backups yet. Click "Create Backup" to get started.
backup.confirmRestoreDesc: Restores configuration and www files from {{filename}}, overwriting matching files. If included, the SQL dump is executed and can change existing databases. Files in external project folders are not restored. A failure may leave partial changes. Back up your current state first.
backup.restoreComplete: Restore complete. Please restart services for changes to take effect.

databaseWorkspace.exportDescription: Export one or more local databases. Each database gets a separate file; ZIP bundles the files with a versioned manifest.
databaseWorkspace.exportPolicy: Schema exports include views, triggers, routines and events. Data-only exports require compatible existing tables. Consistent snapshots apply to transactional tables; avoid schema changes during export. Separate database exports are not a server-wide snapshot.
databaseWorkspace.backupSelected: Back up selected to managed folder
databaseWorkspace.offlineTransfers: MySQL is not running. Start it from Services to perform database operations. Saved backups and activity remain available.
databaseWorkspace.importDescription: Choose SQL, SQL.GZ, a ZIP containing one SQL file at its root, or a DevStackBox ZIP package. Jobs run sequentially and stop after the first failure. Review existing targets and take a backup before importing.
databaseWorkspace.existingTarget: Existing target: SQL may modify or delete its objects and data.
databaseWorkspace.newTarget: The initial database will be created if missing.
databaseWorkspace.originalNames: Uses database names in the SQL or package. Import original-name files individually.
databaseWorkspace.importRisk: Risk review, not a SQL guarantee: an initial database does not confine SQL to that database. Files may contain USE, DROP or statements affecting other databases, accounts or server settings. Import only trusted files. Failure or cancellation can leave partial changes; no automatic rollback is performed.
databaseWorkspace.reviewAcknowledgement: I reviewed these files, target names, compatibility and existing-data risks. I understand that changes may extend beyond the initial database.
databaseWorkspace.backupDescription: Managed database dumps. File integrity and successful restore verification are different checks. Existing backups remain on disk; use full-server tools for legacy backups and full-server operations.
databaseWorkspace.deleteBackupWarning: This deletes the backup file, not the database. Type its database name to confirm:
databaseWorkspace.activityDescription: Native jobs keep running while you navigate. They do not automatically resume after app exit or a crash. Completed items are preserved; imports require a fresh review before retrying.
databaseWorkspace.metadataNote: Sizes and row counts are estimates. Views are listed separately. Use phpMyAdmin to edit tables or run SQL.
databaseWorkspace.name: Name
databaseWorkspace.grantLimitations: This editor manages direct database grants only. Global, role, table and routine privileges can also provide access and are preserved. Use phpMyAdmin for advanced permission administration.
databaseWorkspace.grantWarning: Read/write does not include schema migrations. CREATE, ALTER, INDEX or DROP must be selected explicitly. Changes apply only to this username and host.
databaseWorkspace.authenticationNote: Authentication string presence is not a password-strength or account-security assessment.
databaseWorkspace.operationActive: A database operation is running. View its progress in Import & Export → Activity.
databaseWorkspace.serverBackupWarning: Full-server dumps include MySQL system schemas and may affect accounts and credentials when restored. They are not interchangeable with application-database exports. Test recovery on an isolated compatible MySQL server.
databaseWorkspace.serverBackupAcknowledgement: I understand the full-server scope and recovery limitations.
databaseWorkspace.workspaceDescription: Local databases, accounts, imports, exports and backups.
